Crossing Your Wake

Build 23 — Tenn-Tom Waterway. Drive her, walk her, build on her — then swim ashore and gather what you build with.

Desktop: W/S throttle · A/D rudder · drag to look · G walk/helm · F fish · T rig · V VHF · M radio · I stowage · L ladder · U build level · K shop · Z dive · R aim · C fire · E use · B build · Shift run · Space jump · V view · Tab tablet · ~ admin · Space anchor
Mobile: left stick to drive, drag the right side to look.

The sandbox is the same game, tied up at the yard with full stores and every boat to hand. Time still runs.
